messages:
sophia.billing: FYI vendor Kestrel sent a retrocharge request for invoice INV-2024-071.

miguel.ops: They say usage spike in June was under a partner route that should've been covered by promo.

sophia.billing: Can you drop the CSV and sample logs? need amounts and dates to validate before manual credit.

kestrel (via email): Attached CSV in the ticket — we showed 2,400,000 tokens double-counted for June 12–14. Requesting $4,800 credit. Ticket #4682.

raj.finance: tagging for approval — manual adjustment >$1k needs controller sign-off. @emma.pm can you approve provisional credit while we reconcile?

emma.pm: OK to provisionally approve up to $5k pending docs. Need GL code and memo for audit.

miguel.ops: attached short extract: 
``
account,date,tokens
kestrel,2024-06-12,1200000
kestrel,2024-06-13,800000
kestrel,2024-06-14,400000
```
looks like ingestion pipeline replayed requests.

sophia.billing: Verified against billing export. Confirmed duplicate ingestion tag on those days. Proposed adjustment: credit $4,800 to invoice INV-2024-071 (promo code retro applied).

raj.finance: Please prepare JE with memo "retrocharge correction - duplicated ingestion". GL: 6200 (COGS) credit, 2200 (Accounts Payable) debit. Attach ticket ID.

billing-bot: Created adjustment ADJ-2024-920 in staging. Manual review required.

emma.pm: Approved provisional credit. @raj.finance please finalize and send credit note. Keep audit trail in Confluence page /finance/credits/ADJ-2024-920.

sophia.billing: Will run the final job tonight, will post confirmation when credit posts. :thumbsup:

miguel.ops: filed a follow-up with infra to fix replay. ticket INF-887.

sophia.billing: CREDIT POSTED to Kestrel today. INV-2024-071 now shows balance 0. Closing thread.
